question.text: A Cat III AIF's typical Trustee must be:

answer.text: A person of ability, integrity, not the Manager/director/officer of the AMC

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 3.3.1.3, Trustee must be person of integrity and NOT the Manager/director/officer of the AMC (independence). The Trap: Other restrictions don't capture independence requirement. Cross-Exam Context: Also tested in Topic 2. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Require Trustee to submit annual independence declaration.
